event.description: What happened, for example google_login, google_link, google_refused, credential_namespace_migrated

provider.description: Identity provider involved, for example google or password

outcome.description: Whether the attempt resulted in a session

reason.description: Stable machine readable code, for example NOT_REGISTERED or BAD_AUDIENCE

subject_email.description: Address the attempt named. Never a token, code or secret.

user_id.description: DashFlo user the attempt resolved to, when it resolved to one

detail.description: Human readable context. Must never contain an ID token, authorization code, access token, refresh token, client secret or API key value.
